title: Make time for a habit
instruction: Watch Paul and Emir talk about meditation. Compare their habits, then describe something you do to relax

video.title: Talking about personal interests — British Council | English

items.prompt: What activity do Paul and Emir both do?
items.hint: Listen for the activity Paul has recently started
Listen for a part of the day
items.answer: Emir usually meditates in the mornings

items.hint: Listen for a number followed by a week
items.answer: Paul meditates once or twice a week

items.prompt: What do you do to relax, and how often do you do it? Ask your teacher, too
items.hint: Say what you do and how often, then ask How often do you…?
items.answer: Example: I go for a walk twice a week. How often do you go for a walk?
